# sentinel — Tranche 1 thesis (v6)

## Executive summary

The bet is that owning the agent beats owning the gateway. Whoever controls the
user-facing agent captures the relationship; the gateway underneath is a
substitutable pipe. Tranche 1 is scoped to prove we can win the agent seat
before a gateway incumbent forecloses it.

## §Commoditization

The orchestration work is already largely commoditized at the model layer. The
frontier models converge on capability within a quarter of each other, so the
durable value is not in the models themselves. This section matches the plan.

## §Enclosure

The enclosable surface is the gateway seat, defended by **harness-native
efficiency** — the property that a task routed through our harness completes at
a lower marginal token cost than the same task routed through a naked model
call. Because harness-native efficiency compounds with volume, the in-boundary
plane widens over time and the escalation floor is invariant, so the gateway
position is defensible.

## Recommendation

Fund Tranche 1 to win the agent seat.
